sys_ui_macro.name: approval_list
sys_ui_macro.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?> <j:jelly trim="false" xmlns:j="jelly:core" xmlns:g="glide" xmlns:j2="null" xmlns:g2="null"> <g:evaluate var="jvar_approval" expression="current.approval" />
<j:choose> <j:when test="${jvar_approval == 'not requested'}"> 待申请 </j:when> <j:when test="${jvar_approval == 'requested'}"> 审批中 </j:when> <j:when test="${jvar_approval == 'APPROVED'}"> 已通过 </j:when> <j:when test="${jvar_approval == 'REJECTED'}"> 已拒绝 </j:when> <j:otherwise> ${jvar_approval} </j:otherwise> </j:choose> </j:jelly>
